subject: Locale fallback causing invite -> login redirect loop for ForgeApps (Coupa invite)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Locale fallback causing invite -> login redirect loop for ForgeApps (Coupa invite)

Hi Laura / ForgeApps support team,

Thanks for working with us on the Coupa onboarding. ForgeApps reported they cannot accept the invite we sent — after clicking the invite link the browser cycles between the login page and a tenant selection redirect, and eventually shows a 401 with a JSON error in the console. I attached a screenshot of the 401 and the original ariba-style invite we sent.

Symptoms we see from the customer (Chrome, macOS):
- Clicking invite redirects to login -> selects tenant -> then back to invite link -> repeats 
- Clearing cookies once allows a single successful accept but the issue reappears on subsequent invites
- Error in network console: 401 response with body: {"error":"tenant_preference_mismatch", "detail":"locale fallback to tenant X failed"}

Can you confirm whether the invite flow relies on a tenant-preference cookie and whether a mismatched Accept-Language/locale param could be causing the server to redirect to a fallback tenant that doesn't have the invite bound, leading to the loop?

Work requested:
1) Can you review logs for the raw invite token (I attached ariba-invite.eml) and confirm which tenant id the token was scoped to?
2) Is there a safe server-side fallback we can enable (or a short-term toggle) that preserves the invite -> accept path even when locale/tenant-preference cookie differs?
3) If a client-side workaround exists, what should we advise customers to do beyond "clear cookies"? A small script or link to force the tenant param would be helpful.

I can repro this on a test account and provide session ids if useful. We need a fix because ForgeApps is in validation and this is blocking PO acceptance for their first supplier.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Locale fallback causing invite -> login redirect loop for ForgeApps (Coupa invite)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the detailed report — Laura is OOO this morning so I'm jumping in. We pulled the logs for the invite token provided in ariba-invite.eml. Observations:
- Invite token was issued scoped to tenant_id: tenant-09b5
- When the initial request arrives with an Accept-Language header of "fr-FR,fr;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7" the router attempts tenant resolution using the cookie tenant_preference=v2-fr which maps to tenant-09c2 (a fallback tenant).
- The fallback tenant (tenant-09c2) does not have the invite mapping for that token, so the application issues a redirect back to the invite URL which triggers the same tenant resolution again — loop.

This is a cookie/tenant resolution edge case that happens if a user previously visited a region/language-specific tenant. We can reproduce locally with a pre-set tenant_preference cookie.

Temporary mitigation:
- We generated a one-time magic link for the affected invite that forces tenant_id=tenant-09b5 in the query string and bypasses tenant resolution: (attachment: temporary-magic-link.txt). Please relay to the customer; it will be valid for 48 hours.

Longer-term options:
1) Server-side: if invite token is present, prefer token-scoped tenant_id over the tenant_preference cookie. We can propose a minimal patch to short-circuit tenant resolution when an invite parameter is supplied.
2) Client-side guidance: clear cookies OR append &tenant_id=tenant-09b5 to the invite URL.

Let us know if you want us to open a support ticket and schedule the patch — we estimate ~2-3 days for the safe toggle and ~1 sprint for full fix.

Laura will follow up with the patch plan when she's back.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Support Engineer, ForgeApps
support@forgeapps.com

Attachment: temporary-magic-link.txt

Subject: Fwd: Locale fallback causing invite -> login redirect loop for ForgeApps (Coupa invite)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding ForgeApps support reply. TL;DR: tenant_preference cookie can win over invite-scoped tenant_id, causing a redirect loop when the fallback tenant lacks the invite. ForgeApps offered a one-time magic link and suggested a server-side short-circuit (prefer invite token tenant_id).

Impact: blocks this customer's supplier acceptance; likely to hit other buyers with localized tenants. Recommended next steps:
- Can product/engineering prioritize a short toggle to prefer invite-scoped tenant when present? (low risk; isolates to invite flow).
- If not possible quickly, we should issue the magic links and document the temporary workaround for CS.

Marissa: can you flag this as an operational risk for other onboarding flows and loop in Eng on ONBOARD-4123?

Thanks,
Ben
